title: SimpleX Chat: messaging without an identity

intro.headline: A messenger with no phone number, no username, no user ID.
intro.subhead: SimpleX connects people through one-time invitation links and end-to-end encryption instead of user accounts — so there is nothing on any server to leak, scrape, or spam.

outro.headline: Message like it's nobody's business — because it isn't.
outro.subhead: No phone number to harvest, no profile to breach, no metadata to subpoena. Share an invitation link and start talking.
